Physical pp424-425 define DamageFailureMode.PROB and separate consequence investigation. The accepted H03.var01 parent proves one position FM's BATTLE-HIT-to-CM route; installed dictionary pins FailureMode, CMLocation and DamageFailureMode keys.

The child retains BATTLE-HIT DAMP1, seed1, three missions, horizon36, POS-A FM-POS-A PROB1 and half-hour BASE-01 CM. It adds FM-POS-B on the same POS-A with positive ordinary FRQ1e-9/OPHOURS and CRITF1, a BASE-01 CMLocation direct CM of one hour, and DamageFailureMode.PROB1 for the same BATTLE-HIT; only description otherwise changes.

pre_run_hypotheses.control: The byte-identical parent should reproduce three damage-induced FM-POS-A consequences, three half-hour CM repairs and terminal readiness.
pre_run_hypotheses.two_mode: At each BATTLE-HIT occurrence both configured failure modes may appear on POS-A. Native FM identities, CM task order/duration, mission state, repair occupancy and terminal state decide the accepted claim. Parallel versus serial processing is not preaccepted.
pre_run_hypotheses.alternatives: Conversion rejection, an ordinary random failure, suppressed second mode, incomplete repair, shortage, cancellation or ledger mismatch is diagnostic until explained. One deterministic seed does not prove probabilistic independence.
